newsitem.title: INDIA: India sugar market closed to mark Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: India sugar market closed to mark Hindu festival.

text.p: The Bombay sugar market was shut on Wednesday to mark a Hindu festival.
"Actually attendance among traders was average but trading remained suspended due to stoppage of work by loaders and unloaders in the market," dealer said.
"Loaders and unloaders are celebrating the festival and refrained from work," one broker said.
On Tuesday sugar prices in ready delivery rose by 10/15 rupees at 1,480/1,500 rupees per quintal for the S-30 variety and by 10 rupees at 1,500/1,550 rupees per quintal for the M-30 variety.
The market will reopen for trading on Thursday.
